note: MUFG Bank's explanation of its ordinary deposit account (as of 1 May 2023, the edition it publishes): its fee section names no fee for keeping the account, only card fees, an unused-account fee (an account opened from July 2021 with no deposit or withdrawal for two years is charged 1,320 yen a year as unused) and a paper-passbook fee (for accounts from April 2022, 550 yen a year), neither of which the game's account incurs.
